events.description: Board of Directors approved an increase in the annual dividend for fiscal 2013 to .59 per share, to be paid in four quarterly installments of -bash.3975 per share
events.source_quote: On March 1, 2012, the Board of Directors approved an increase in the annual dividend for fiscal 2013 to .59 per share, an increase of approximately 9% over the .46 per share dividend paid in fiscal 2012. For fiscal 2013, the annual dividend will be paid in four quarterly installments of -bash.3975 per share

events.description: Pending acquisition of the remaining equity interest in Bounteous Company Limited (BCL), which operates in China under the Trust-Mart banner
events.source_quote: Pursuant to the Share Purchase Agreement, the Company was committed to purchase the remaining interest in BCL. The Company expects to complete its acquisition of the remaining equity interest in BCL in the second quarter of fiscal 2013.

events.description: The Company filed a Motion to Dismiss on March 5, 2012, in the gender discrimination lawsuit Odle v. Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. in Texas
events.source_quote: On October 28, 2011, the plaintiffs’ attorneys filed a complaint in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas entitled Odle v. Wal-Mart Stores, Inc., proposing a class of current and former female associates at the Company’s Texas retail facilities, and the Company filed a Motion to Dismiss on March 5, 2012.

events.description: Wal-Mart Puerto Rico, Inc. presented documentation demonstrating compliance to the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) on March 22, 2012, regarding creek and wetland permit violations in Caguas
events.source_quote: On March 22, 2012, Wal-Mart Puerto Rico presented documentation demonstrating compliance to the USACE.

events.description: The Company received notice in a letter dated April 24, 2012, that the Riverside County District Attorney decided not to pursue further action regarding landfill construction disposal violations
events.source_quote: The Company received notice in a letter dated April 24, 2012, that the District Attorney’s office has decided not to pursue any further action with regard to this matter.
